purpose: Auditable footprint of original FootyEdge source adapters; NOT permission to archive or redistribute each provider's output.

existing_application_sources.data_license: Provider terms apply; do not relicense/ bulk-republish as CC0

existing_application_sources.name: API-Football
existing_application_sources.role: fixture/lineup stats when a valid key and limits permit

existing_application_sources.role: exact sportsbook quotes; separately timestamped and freeze-governed

existing_application_sources.name: ESPN-listed sportsbook market quotes

existing_application_sources.data_license: Validate original source license for every dataset

existing_application_sources.name: StatsBomb Open Data
existing_application_sources.data_license: Selected open-data license and attribution; not globally unrestricted

existing_application_sources.name: Understat / soccerdata
existing_application_sources.role: optional match-level shot events in shadow research
existing_application_sources.data_license: Check provider terms before automated ingestion or redistribution

existing_application_sources.name: Football-Data.co.uk
existing_application_sources.role: legacy research-only CSV scouting used by shadow pipeline
existing_application_sources.data_license: Site terms restrict some automated/AI/commercial uses; require authorization

reference_only.name: FBref
reference_only.role: manual fact cross-check only; no bulk automated historical replication

reference_only.name: FootyStats
reference_only.role: optional licensed plan only, not redistributed into CC0 history

rule: Only explicitly verified OpenFootball CC0 completed scores go into the public historical mirror. Existing API pipelines remain independently gated; no guessing odds/EV, stripping provenance, or changing dated boards.
